sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the informant in the said case and same is pending since 2024.

It is also submitted that the opposite party no.2 is not cooperating with the Court concerned and is adopting delaying tactics in disposal of the said case and only dates are being fixed in the matter.
The Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said case.
The opposite party no.2 has not appeared so far in the matter.
4. Learned AGA opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6. It reveals from the perusal of the order sheets that the case is pending at the stage of appearance of opposite party no.2.

In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to invoke the powers given to it under law to ensure the presence of the opposite party no. 2 by sending appropriate process within two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, if there is no legal impediment.
It is further directed that no unnecessary adjournment will be sought/granted.

7. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
